book.title: 1 Korint Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Korint

content: Nǝhanian lototutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab gail

Gagai nuke nisor husur namǝŋod nǝvanuan gail lototutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab gail. Evoi, datolǝboii ke, “gidat p̃isi datukad nalǝboian.” Nalǝboian igol nǝvanuan epul am hǝn naṽivan. Be na-lǝmas-buni-an igol nǝmauran sinǝvanuan idaŋ am.
Avan ideh b̃inau suluṽi ke tolǝboi natit tosob̃ur; gai salǝboi natit lotokitin aGot toke b̃ikel vǝhot gail maii sal.
Be avan ideh b̃elǝmas bun aGot, aGot elǝboi avan enan.
Ale, nǝhanan hǝn namǝŋod lototutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab beti: Gidat p̃isi datolǝboii ke nǝlablab savi natideh len navile a pan, ale sǝkad nagot ideh be aGot tosua ŋai.
Ikad nagot gǝgǝras tosob̃ur nǝvanuan gail lotolotu hǝn gail. Luke nagot galenan lutoh len nǝmav o len navile eg a pan, ale loriŋ gail hum lotovi got mai masta salit gail.

Avil naut kǝmas natenan, gidat datolǝboii ke ikad aGot tosua ŋai, aTata tovi nǝkadun natit p̃isi. Ale gidat datutoh m̃osi. Ale ikad aMasta tosua ŋai, aYesu Kristo. Len aKristo, aGot igol natit p̃isi toum hǝni; ale len aKristo, datukad nǝmauran.

Be savi nǝvanuan p̃isi lotolǝboi natenan. Ikad nǝvanuan nadǝlomian galevis lǝsǝnau sǝhoti sal ke nǝlablab lǝsǝkad nǝdaŋan ideh. Ale nǝboŋ lotohan namǝŋod tovi naviolan van hǝn nǝlablab, lunau suluṽi ke lotolotu van hǝn nǝlablab enan. Ale husur lǝsail sǝdaŋ len aGot sal, nǝsa lotogole igol nǝlolit eb̃iŋb̃iŋal.
Be nǝhanian edǝdas b̃igol datb̃ikad navoivoian mai aGot. Husur datb̃ihani o asike datb̃ihani, gǝlar p̃isi arsavi natideh len aGot.
Be mǝtelǝlǝgau hǝn gamit gabag. Nǝdaŋan mǝttokade len nǝmakuvan samit dan nǝsaan satigol alat lǝsǝdaŋ len nadǝlomian liteh.

Husur, gaiug gotokad “nalǝboian,” avan ideh nǝnauan sail gǝgat b̃eris gotohan len naim nalotuan silablab, nǝsa bai? Hum ma nǝdaŋan sam̃ b̃eliv nǝnauan san gol b̃ihan namǝŋod lototutumav hǝni tia van hǝn nǝlablab. B̃igol b̃imaienan, igol nǝsaan.
Imagenan, len nalǝboian sam̃, gomǝdas awawa sǝdaŋ len nadǝlomian, gomǝdas awawa len nadǝlomian, aKristo tomat m̃osi.
Mǝtb̃igol nǝsaan maienan van hǝn nǝbathudud ideh sǝdaŋ len nadǝlomian, mǝtugol nasǝnahan len nǝlon, ale mǝtugol nǝsaan van hǝn aKristo.
Bathut natenan, nǝsa nǝb̃ihani b̃igol awawa len nadǝlomian b̃iteh, sanihan namǝŋod boŋ ideh am. Husur nomǝtahun nǝb̃igol awawa ideh len nadǝlomian b̃iteh.

footnotes.text: 8.3 Natosian galevis ta sutuai luke, Avan ideh b̃inau suluṽi ke tokad nalǝboian, gai sǝkad nalǝboian kitin. 3 Be nǝvanuan b̃ikad na-lǝmas-buni-an, gai ikad nalǝboian kitin.
8.10 Nǝboŋ toke igol nǝsaan, igol nǝsaan husur tob̃ur kotov nǝnauan san toke nǝhanan hǝn namǝŋod lototutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab sanor. Ale nǝlon sǝmasil am.
